Okay, so I know this one gets thrown around a lot, but I'll go ahead and say it anyways. My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy**** and here's why:

For one, as a whole, it's pretty much universally agreed upon that it is one of the best Rap Albums of the past however long, and people cite an enormous array of reasons. Even if you take Kanye's whole persona (ergo that the album came out around the time of the Taylor issue, the hype, the ego), the music stands as some of the most finely produced, emotionally moving, brain-meltingly awesome stuff to come out in recent memory. From the title tracks inherent strangeness (the change of tempo on the refrain, the spoken intro), the Chris-Rock cutaway in 'Blame Game' (only in the context of this song could something so crude and funny actually strike some sort of underlying emotional resonance), and the 6+ minute exercise in staring at a mirror and punching it that is 'Runaway,' the collection goes so many places that often you're not knowing what to expect next. The lyrics on the final musical number, 'Lost in the World,' highlight the opposites and confusion that underlay the nonstop shining lights and guilded extravagance that is Kanye's fantasy, and as he sneers "you're my devil/you're my angel/you're my freedom/you're my jail" you realize that even our tour guide may not have the answers. Each listen I find something new. It came out during my first year of med school and it has gotten played too many times a year to count since then; it basically was the soundtrack to my graduate education and I love every second of it. Sit down, pour a whiskey, and give Kanye a chance if you haven't heard this or doubt what I'm writing. It may surprise you.
